SELECT i.id, d.name, d.id AS definition_id, d.revision, d.enabled
FROM ifj_task i JOIN ifj_task_definition d ON d.id = i.current_task_definition_id AND d.task_id = i.id AND d.revision = i.current_revision
FROM ifj_job i JOIN ifj_job_definition d ON d.id = i.current_definition_id AND d.job_id = i.id AND d.revision = i.current_revision
WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.retired = 0FALSE AND i.retired_time IS NULL
SELECT id, job_id, revision, name, timeout, enabled, description, create_time FROM ifj_job_definition WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY revision DESC, id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT g.group_code FROM ifj_job i JOIN ifj_job_definition_group g ON g.definition_id = i.current_definition_id WHERE i.retired = 0FALSE AND i.retired_time IS NULL AND i.current_revision IS NOT NULL AND g.group_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY g.group_code
